description: Free quote for the paid HTTP panel of parallel Solana risk advisors. Pass a Solana mint and optionally comma-separated public advisor aliases from GET /v1/advisors and a CAIP-2 token chain. Returns a canonical HTTP URL and estimated total in USDC; does not call or pay advisors. The URL's HTTP 402 payment quote is authoritative.

advisors.description: Optional comma-separated public advisor aliases from free GET /v1/advisors; omit to select all enabled advisors compatible with the token chain.
advisors.title: Advisors

chain.description: Optional CAIP-2 network ID of the token being analyzed, not the payment network. Defaults to Solana mainnet; other token chains are currently unsupported.
chain.title: Chain

mint.description: Base58 Solana token mint address to analyze through the paid HTTP panel.
mint.title: Mint

name: quote_solana_risk_panel
